messages:
Ravi: Hey all, day 3 here. I found the onboarding templates but I want to propose a change to the Service Onboarding template (adding a DB migration checklist). What's the recommended process to change a canonical template?
Clara: Welcome! :wave: Short answer: propose via the Templates PR flow. Details: duplicate the template in your team space, make the edits, then open a tiny PR in docs-metadata with the page URL + summary of changes. Tag the template steward.
Ravi: Docs-metadata repo? I couldn't find that.
Devex Bot: Link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs-metadata. The repo tracks canonical template schema, TemplateVersion, and migration notes. Use the PR template there: Title: "template-change: <page-path> - short summary".
Clara: Also please add a "TemplateVersion: v2" meta line at the top of your draft and include a short compatibility note (which fields are required/optional). That lets automation detect breaking changes.
Ravi: Who's the steward for Onboarding templates? I don't want to PR without tagging the right person.
Marta: I own the Onboarding templates. Ping me on the PR and I'll review. I prefer minor additions (new optional sections) to be merged quickly; breaking changes require a 48h notice and a migration plan.
Ravi: Nice. How do we notify other teams that rely on the template?
Clara: Add a changelog entry in the docs-metadata CHANGELOG.md and create a short announcement in #eng-notices with the PR link and migration notes. For major changes we schedule a 15m sync with stakeholders listed in the template's Owners field.
Ravi: If I need edit access to the canonical page for small fixes, do I request via form or on the PR?
Marta: Request edit rights via the Request Docs Access form for immediate needs, but still follow the PR/change process so changes are tracked. We avoid direct edits without a linked PR.
Ravi: Is there a semantic versioning scheme?
Clara: Yes: TemplateVersion follows semver-ish rules: v1.0.0 -> v1.1.0 for non-breaking additions, v2.0.0 for breaking changes. Update the TemplateVersion and add migration steps in the PR body.
Ravi: Great, thanks. I'll duplicate, add the DB migration checklist, open a PR in docs-metadata, and tag @Marta.
Marta: Sounds perfect. Ping me if you want a quick review before opening the PR.
Clara: Welcome aboard Ravi 44b
